shared_elements: animals aligned facing the same direction
human body parts (arm/hand, leg) rendered alongside animals
justification: Both are stone reliefs whose animals are shown strictly in profile facing the same direction, with human limbs appearing among them and a horizontal band organising the field, but A stacks isolated, widely spaced creatures in vertical tiers on a narrow pillar while B is a dense horizontal frieze of two overlapping, near-identical beasts. The rendering differs sharply: A is shallow, flat and schematic with sparse incised detail, whereas B is deeply modelled, volumetric and covered in fine ornamental surface patterning.
